name: Pendant and Bell (Bội Ngọc Minh Loan)

bonuses.rule: each hit you take rings the Luan Bell as though the attacker had moved (a light Metal hit and a Metal stack on it), and the Pendants chime back: each chime heals you 1 % of your health, at most once per second.

story: Cast and carved together for the founders' Dao-partner rite in 960, when the bell rang against the jade. In Vương Bột's line the jade pendants and the luan bells fall silent when the feast is over. Yến Bội Ngọc wears both, and the set is whole. The rite robe she wore that day is the third piece; she had it rewoven with a thread of the Winter Crack in 1121, and wears all three.

name: Bridge Bells (Kiều Linh Song Bảo)

bonuses.rule: bells you hang with Hang the Bells answer your hand bell: each time the foe acts, every Bell charge you hold rings once, each a light Metal hit; at most once per second.

story: The hand bell and the jade from home. Thẩm Hưởng Nhi holds both; since 1191 both have answered on nights with no wind.
